scope: API streaming soak; not browser/camera validation or semantic quality grading

policy.growth_rule: Fail if final-window median RSS minus baseline median exceeds max(64 MiB, 5% baseline RSS).
policy.system_ram_growth_rule: Report the same windows separately; system unavailable RAM is not added to RSS.
policy.quality_rule: No semantic grading or exact answer matching; the frozen quality screen is separate.

memory.cuda_allocator_note: Requires backend instrumentation; cannot be inferred from RAM or RSS.
memory.memory_note: Local host observations. Jetson GPU/CPU share RAM. RAM, RSS and allocator counters overlap; do not add them or label system RAM as dedicated VRAM. Peaks are sampled, not exact.

oom_note: The sampled oom_kill counter is system-wide. CUDA/backend failures also reject the run as request errors; this is not CUDA allocator instrumentation.

backend_config.precision: RTN INT4 MLP weights; FP16 attention, LM head, vision, projector, embeddings, activations and KV
backend_config.image_quality: 18/19 synthetic facts, exact baseline outputs on six diagnostic images and90measured LiveVLM requests; yellow-to-orange limitation remains.
backend_config.candidate_change: Batch-one MLP GEMV output tiling2to4 for9216x2048/2048x9216 only, aggregate visual capacity1024to512, KV2048to1664. Same per-image512/input1024/output512 limits and weights.
